title: Rabbi Chama

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 135b: “As the Tannaim dispute — Rabbi Chama says: she gave birth,” etc. This is also Rashi’s reading from the She’iltot. Dikdukei Soferim has Rabbi Abba. Hyman suggests that possibly he is Rabbi Chama, the father of Rabbi Oshaya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman’s full heading is רבי חמא, Rabbi Chama. The William Davidson digital Shabbat 135b paragraph instead fully writes Rav Chama. The source’s full title is retained alongside the witness difference, and the possible identification with Oshaya’s father remains Hyman’s conjecture.

The checked Shabbat 135b passage fully writes Rav Chama and gives the dictum about birth and immersion. Hyman’s heading says Rabbi Chama. His reports about Rashi’s She’iltot reading and Dikdukei Soferim have not been independently collated here; his possible identification with Oshaya’s father remains a conjecture.
